**Observation Log:**

- [FACT] The user is going to build a full stack website.
- [FACT] The user plans to use React.js for the front end.
- [FACT] The user plans to use Express.js for the backend.
- [PREFERENCE] The user wants to add functionality to send a file on multiple social media platforms.
- [PREFERENCE] The user is interested in sending files via LinkedIn, WhatsApp, and email.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] To add the functionality of sending a file on multiple social media platforms, the user can use their respective APIs.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The user should obtain API keys for the social media platforms they want to use.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] LinkedIn has the LinkedIn Marketing Developer Platform.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] WhatsApp has the WhatsApp Business API.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Email services have various APIs such as the Gmail API.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The user should set up API clients in their backend using Express.js.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The user can use libraries like `node-linkedin` for LinkedIn.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The user can use `whatsapp-web.js` for WhatsApp.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The user can use `nodemailer` for email services.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The user should create a route in their backend to handle file uploads and sending it to social media platforms.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The user can use `multer` middleware to handle file uploads.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] In the frontend using React.js, the user should create a form for file uploads and social media platform selection.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] When the user submits the form, they should send a request to the backend route created to handle sending the file.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The backend will handle sending the file to the selected social media platforms using their respective APIs.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The user should handle any errors or exceptions that may occur during the file upload or sending process.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Each social media platform may have different requirements and limitations for sending files through their APIs, so the user should check their documentation for specific details.
